title: Friend's government contact warns him off the Kandahar giant
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Friend's government contact warns him off the Kandahar giant, about unspecified (about the Kandahar giant, c. 2003-2005) at Kandahar, Afghanistan, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: asked him he said hey do you know anything about like this Kandahar giant thing and he said this person who's his friend just totally switched

plain: There is a story that US soldiers near Kandahar, Afghanistan, in the early 2000s came across a giant about 12 feet tall. Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast who looks into the story, says a friend of his asked a contact with government ties about the Kandahar giant, and the contact's whole manner suddenly changed and he warned the friend off. To Alberino, that reaction suggests there is something real being kept quiet.
